facts.summary: Phase 2b missed primary endpoint at all doses · Phase 2b · EVO756 in chronic spontaneous urticaria · not yet approved

evidence.summary: The study did not meet the primary endpoint of mean change in a patient’s Urticaria Activity Score over seven days (UAS7) at 12 weeks at any dose.
evidence.primary_endpoint_met: The study did not meet the primary endpoint of mean change in a patient’s Urticaria Activity Score over seven days (UAS7) at 12 weeks at any dose.
evidence.safety: this Phase 2b trial confirmed safe and well tolerated doses that warrant these further studies
evidence.program_discontinued: the lack of efficacy demonstrated at Week 12 in this Phase 2b trial does not support further development of EVO756 for CSU
